主要内容: On January 13, 2012, SAP AG, a German-based company, issued a press release announcing its preliminary financial results for the fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2011. The press release is included as Exhibit 99.1 and provides details on non-IFRS financial measures, which are not prepared in accordance with IFRS. These measures should be considered in addition to, and not as substitutes for, financial performance metrics prepared under IFRS. The document also includes forward-looking statements, which are subject to risks and uncertainties. SAP undertakes no obligation to update these statements. The report is filed under Form 6-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. This document is a Form 6-K filing by SAP AG, dated January 17, 2012. It includes a press release dated January 13, 2012, and signatures from the CFO and Chief Accounting Officer. The filing is in compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The press release is listed as Exhibit 99.1 and is part of the report. The document outlines the company's official filing and includes the necessary signatures from authorized representatives.
